verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item describes any opt-out, privacy control, or policy allowing users to prevent their data from being used to train AI models; Expensify's AI features (e.g., 'Ask Expensify AI') are documented only in terms of functionality, not data-use controls. Community evidence even suggests receipt data has been handled by third-party human contractors without confidentiality protections, further indicating no user-facing AI-training opt-out exists.
